title: Software engineering summer internship
description: Many tech companies offer summer internships for students with a GitHub portfolio and basic Java or Python.

title: Oracle Java SE certification
description: A recognised certificate that shows strong Java and OOP knowledge.

title: Junior software developer
description: Usually asks for programming, Git, databases and teamwork.

title: Front-end developer internship
description: Look for internships where you build real web pages with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.

title: Meta Front-End Developer certificate
description: An online certificate covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.

title: Junior web developer
description: Usually asks for a portfolio website and experience with at least one framework.

title: Data analyst internship
description: Common in banks, government entities and consulting firms, usually asks for Excel and SQL.

title: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
description: Shows you can build reports and dashboards in Power BI.

title: Junior data analyst
description: Usually asks for SQL, Excel, a visualisation tool and good communication.

title: Architecture firm internship
description: Firms look for students with a strong portfolio and AutoCAD or Revit skills.

title: Autodesk Revit Certified Professional
description: Shows strong BIM skills, which many firms now expect.

title: Junior architect
description: Usually 3 to 5 years before licensing, works on drawings, models and client presentations.

title: Mobile app development internship
description: Companies look for students who have at least one app they can show on their phone.

title: Meta Android or iOS Developer certificate
description: Online certificates that cover building and publishing mobile apps.

title: Junior mobile developer
description: Usually asks for Kotlin or Swift, APIs, Git and a portfolio of apps.

title: UX design internship
description: Look for internships where you take part in user research and design reviews.

title: Google UX Design certificate
description: An online certificate that takes you through the full design process with portfolio projects.

title: Junior UI/UX designer
description: Usually asks for a portfolio with 3 or more case studies and Figma skills.
